Scoring Breakdown Guide

The compatibility score (0–100 pts) is computed as:

Total = 100 − (PesoPenalty + EdadPenalty + EstaturaPenalty + DoyangPenalty + CintaPenalty)

Penalties are calculated using: penalty = max × (diff / threshold) ^ 1.8

ComponentMax PenaltyThresholdDescription
Peso405 kgdiff_peso / 5
Edad301 añodiff_edad / 1
Estatura2010 cmdiff_estatura / 10
Doyang10same doyang+10 if same doyang
Cintaflexiblenivel diff5 × |nivel_c1 − nivel_c2|

MAXIMUM = 100 pts (identical competitors + different doyang + same cinta level)

Score thresholds:

  • ≥ 70 pts → Excelente (no approval needed)
  • 50–69 pts → Aceptable
  • < 50 pts → Bajo (may require approval)
